turns.question: What share of the Geneva urban renewal tax increment does the Redevelopment Agency capture?

[1] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in each phase for a maximum period of 25 years in each phase and a maximum period of 40 years for all phases within the Project Area. [1] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase 3C - James Bay area. [3] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase 4B & Phase 3C areas. [1][2] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the entire Geneva Project Area. [1][2] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase I, Phase II, and Phase III areas. [1][2] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase I (Area 95) and Phase I (Area 96) areas. [2]

turns.question: What share of the Geneva urban renewal tax increment does the Redevelopment Agency capture?
turns.answer: The Redevelopment Agency captures 75% of the tax increment from the Geneva Urban Renewal Area. [1][2] The Agency proposes capturing 75 percent of the tax increment with a cap of $300 million. [1] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in each phase for a maximum period of 25 years in each phase and a maximum period of 40 years for all phases within the Project Area. [1] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase 3C - James Bay. [3] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase 4B & Phase 3C. [1][2] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase I, Phase II, and Phase III. [2] The Agency captures 75% of the tax increment in the Phase I (Area 95), Phase I (Area 96), Phase II, and Phase III. [2]
